verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports natural-language interaction to inspect code, run commands, pass error screenshots/diagrams, run reviews against diffs/commits, and use live web search when debugging depends on external context (codex-docs-8,9,10,12,14). This covers core debugging/troubleshooting workflows via NL prompts, with community reports of it successfully diagnosing/fixing issues (codex-comm-12). However, there's no dedicated 'debug' feature or structured troubleshooting workflow beyond general coding-agent capability, and some community feedback questions reliability/agentic quality (codex-comm-2, codex-comm-11). Missing for 10: dedicated debugging-specific tooling (e.g., log analysis, stack-trace triage features), independent benchmarks specifically on debugging tasks, and stronger corroboration beyond mixed anecdotal reports.
